name: How long does hallway lighting installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does hallway lighting installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a hallway lighting installation project depends on its complexity and scope. A simple replacement of a few existing fixtures might take half a day. However, installing new recessed lighting in a long hallway, which requires running new wiring, cutting multiple holes, and potentially installing new switches, can take one to two full days or more. We provide a projected timeline in our proposal after understanding the specifics of your project during the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies, from a half-day for simple replacements to one to two days or more for complex projects requiring new wiring and multiple fixtures.
